![Best Time to Visit Vanuatu: Weather & Best Months](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/11010849-1363-0139-0000-4d4a0b4f1bbb:4)
The best time to visit Vanuatu is during the **dry season from April to October** , when the weather is warm, sunny, and less humid.[[1]](https://www.myvanuatu.com.au/blog/the-best-time-to-visit-vanuatu/)[[2]](https://www.virginaustralia.com/au/en/destinations/vanuatu/best-times-to-visit-vanuatu/)

### Key Seasons at a Glance

- **Dry Season (April to October):** 
	- Temperatures range from 18°C to 28°C (64°F–82°F).
	- Ideal for hiking, volcano trekking, island-hopping, and scuba diving.
	- Shoulder months like **May, early June, and September** offer the best mix of great weather, smaller crowds, and reasonable prices.[[1]](https://www.virginaustralia.com/au/en/destinations/vanuatu/best-times-to-visit-vanuatu/)[[2]](https://www.intrepidtravel.com/en/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit-vanuatu)[[3]](https://www.intrepidtravel.com/us/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit-vanuatu)[[4]](https://www.traveloka.com/en-au/explore/destination/the-best-time-to-visit-vanuatu-what-to-expect-each-season-acc/1010769)[[5]](https://www.myvanuatu.com.au/travel-guide/seasons-weather/)
- **Wet / Cyclone Season (November to April):** 
	- Temperatures are hotter and more humid (around 28°C or higher), with frequent tropical storms.
	- Cyclone risk peaks between **January and April**.
	- February and March are the wettest months, offering the lowest prices and very few tourists.[[1]](https://www.intrepidtravel.com/en/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit-vanuatu)[[2]](https://www.vanuatu.travel/en/things-to-know/travel-tips/weather)[[3]](https://www.intrepidtravel.com/nl/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit-vanuatu)[[4]](https://www.virginaustralia.com/au/en/destinations/vanuatu/best-times-to-visit-vanuatu/)

### Best Times by Activity

- **Snorkeling and Diving:** April to September (calm seas and clear water).
- **Surfing:** March to December (great conditions at spots like Pango Point and Breakas).
- **Cultural Festivals (Naghol Land Diving):** April to June in Pentecost Island.
- **Budget Travel:** February and March for the lowest rates, or the shoulder windows of May and September.[[1]](https://www.travelonline.com/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit)[[2]](https://www.virginaustralia.com/au/en/destinations/vanuatu/best-times-to-visit-vanuatu/)[[3]](https://www.myvanuatu.com.au/blog/the-best-time-to-visit-vanuatu/)[[4]](https://www.intrepidtravel.com/en/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit-vanuatu)

You can check current seasonal travel advisories and weather updates on the [Vanuatu Tourism Office](https://www.vanuatu.travel/en/things-to-know/travel-tips/weather) website.[[1]](https://www.vanuatu.travel/en/things-to-know/travel-tips/weather)If you'd like, let me know:
